channel.title: Ghostex Updates
channel.description: Sparkle appcast for Ghostex macOS releases.

item.description:
# Ghostex 11.1.1
## 11.1.1 - 2026-11-08
**Ghostex 11.1.1 is out.** Connected computers ask for your approval once instead of over and over, the pair-again notice walks you through each device, the settings that open your computer up are yours alone, agent skills arrive signed, Linux follows COSMIC's display scale, and many fixes.
### 🔐 Security and pairing
- **A connected computer asks once:** one approval card per pair of computers, never a PIN prompt every minute, and with Agent access off it never asks at all. - **The pair-again notice lists each device on its own row** with one status and a page per device, and tells you the good news: the security review is done and pairing again takes a moment. It asks for a pairing code only after you press Show code. - **Phones that sign in over SSH or Tailscale pair with matching words**, a re-paired computer counts as paired, and a phone you deny is told so. Every Easy Connect copy gives a code that can pair. - **Some things are yours alone, in Settings:** installing or turning on an extension and its permissions, secret providers, joining or setting up a team, and the settings that loosen security. Agents can't ask for these; they point you to the page. - **Install from folder… in Settings > Extensions** installs an extension from a folder, with the permissions you tick. - **Agents ask once per project:** the first time an agent reaches another project's sessions it asks you, and then it can go on without asking again. - **Secret requests are answered only by you**, and each one is tied to the session that asked. - **Agent skills that update between releases install only when Ghostex signed them.** - **Cloud Boxes ask you before an agent puts your logins or a project's secrets on a box.**
### 💬 Chat and sessions
- **The handover headings are coloured:** Needs you pink like the sidebar's question dot, Blocked red like its red dot, and Kicked off sky blue. - **A message held because the agent's input box is off screen heals itself**, reloading the agent after a few minutes when nothing else brings the box back, and Claude Code's rating survey no longer holds a message for hours. - **An automatic reload or restart waits while the agent still has background jobs running.** - **Chief's row is drawn like a project header**, its name lined up with the projects and its flower turning into the fold chevron, on the computer and the phone. - **Clicking a Global Action in the Start menu runs it** (#501). - **A coordinator's thread on a connected computer starts in a worktree without stopping at the folder-trust question** (#502), and a stale "not moving" report is dropped instead of arriving late.
### 📲 On the phone
- **Calmer notifications:** the bell's rows read like the desktop's cards with the session's name, and a blocked session shows its red dot with the reason in its menu. - **The phone calls it the Easy Connect code** everywhere you paste or scan it.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Linux: Ghostex follows COSMIC's display scale**, Settings > Interface has a Linux-only Display scale row, and a raised Interface scale is offered a one-time reset (#503). - **Switches are clearer:** an on switch is a mid-tone track under a white handle. - **Spaces and playbook sync fixes:** each folder of a repository keeps its own playbook, a newcomer takes the shared Spaces, Settings > Sync lists projects that sync moved, and sync waits for git remotes after a start (#488). - **Alert me for says what each choice changes.** - **A session of a removed custom agent is named by its base agent**, not its raw id.

# Ghostex 11.1.0
## 11.1.0 - 2026-11-08
**Ghostex 11.1.0 is out.** A security update that puts you in charge of everything sensitive, with safer pairing for phones and computers (including over SSH and Tailscale); Collab becomes an extension you install, with a new Share popover; Chief, one agent per computer you can ask about anything; calmer notifications; a calm card when a computer is offline, with messages held until it is back; Settings in six groups; and many fixes.
### 🔐 Security update - **You approve what matters:** turning on Easy Connect, letting a computer connect, Autopilot's approvals and limits, GBots, settings that loosen security, and an agent answering, stopping or typing into another session all wait for your approval with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your system password, or Face ID or the fingerprint on your phone. - **Agents and scripts can ask but never approve:** every session gets its own key when it starts, the `ghostex` CLI waits for your approval and then repeats the call, and settings only you may change can't be written through the API. - **Settings > Security keeps a security log** of every sensitive action, chained so an edited or removed entry is flagged; `ghostex security log` shows it in a terminal, and only the important entries reach the bell and the phone. - **Easy Connect serves only SSH and Ghostex itself**, an empty allow-list lets nobody in, and file links never open keys, Ghostex's own data or a project's hidden files like `.env`. - **Every downloadable component (Collab, GBots, the browser engine) carries Ghostex's signature**, checked before it is unpacked. - **After updating, a one-time notice lists the phones and computers that connect through Easy Connect and must pair again**, with the pairing QR right there, ticking each one off as it pairs; phones and computers on Tailscale, your network or SSH keep working.
### 📲 Pairing phones and computers - **Each phone pairs with its own device key** kept in the Secure Enclave or Android Keystore: it waits as Pending with three words, and you approve it on the computer, or on a phone already paired, only when the words match. Removing a phone cuts it off at once. - **Computers pair the same way:** paste a Show QR code into Add a machine, check the three words on both screens and approve. - **Phones that sign in over Tailscale, your network or SSH pair once too**, with the same three matching words; until then answers, Stop and typing from that phone wait for your approval. Run in terminal on the phone uses the phone's own key. - **Pairing again needs the new phone app** (Android in this release, iPhone on TestFlight).
### 🤝 Ghostex Collab - **Collab is now an extension:** the Ghostex you download doesn't contain it until you install it from Settings > Extensions (or right in the Share popover), with Touch ID; Settings > Collab and Share appear once it is installed, and Uninstall ends every share. - **The new Share popover is the live panel:** the link and code, who is watching and who is waiting, a Link lasts chip with 1 hour, 4 hours, 24 hours or Until I stop it, Review for a guest's waiting message, and Stop sharing that says who gets disconnected. The phone's Share sheet matches. - **Every share, Send mode and guest message you send on asks for your approval**, links need an eight-digit code, and the guest page is pinned to the exact version your Ghostex trusts. - **Guests can answer the agent's questions and open the chat's Ghostex pages and pictures**, and the guest page works on phones; their answers wait for you like their messages. - **Collab and GBots show in Settings > Updates and the Updates menu** with Update when a new version is out.
### 🌸 Chief - **Chief is one agent per computer you can ask about anything:** any session, agent, project or computer, and Ghostex itself. Its row with the Ghostex flower sits under the Spaces bar, on the computer and the phone. - **Chief reads every session and steers them for you** (messages, interrupts, answers prompts) without asking each time, hands project work to that project's coordinator, and leaves security, sharing and pairing to you. "Ask anything about Ghostex" in the Help menu opens its chat. - **Each computer has its own Chief**, and you can turn it off in Settings > Extensions > Chief.
### 🔔 Notifications - **Alerts come only when a session needs you:** a thread finishing stays quiet, a coordinator alerts only when its handover needs you, and every red dot alerts unless Autopilot heals it. - **The phone's bell is an inbox of sessions** under Needs you, Done and Failed, one row each, and Android's persistent notification follows it, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The bell's dot counts only the rows its panel lists.**
### 🌐 Remote computers - **A calm "Windows PC is offline · last seen 2h ago" card** sits above the chat box when a computer is off or asleep, with Retry; a message you send then waits and goes out by itself when the computer is back, with Cancel. - **Machines that ask for a verification code (2FA) connect:** turn on Reuse an existing SSH connection in the machine's Advanced settings and sign in once in a terminal, thanks to @chen1plus. - **Updates covers every connected computer**, with Install for what one of them is missing. - **Autopilot and Not moving wait while the computer is offline** instead of nudging agents that can't hear them. - **Easy Connect recovers faster** after a stall or a network change on the phone.
### 🧭 Coordinators - **Playbook overrides replace editing the playbook**, and the coordinator picks which memory notes go into a thread's brief. - **A coordinator links its own threads on another computer**, and a thread's brief there waits out a folder-trust prompt (#497, #502). - **The Start menu lists Global Actions under a Global heading** (#501).
### 💬 Chat - **The agent's reply fades in, and a long one stops the chat at its top** so you read from the start. - **Opening a tool group or any fold at the bottom of the chat scrolls to show its end.** - **A board card mention is its own teal chip with the card's title**, dimmed once the card leaves the board. - **The model menu shows tabs only for agents you turned on**, its long tooltips stay inside the menu, and the "Not applied" reason shows in full, thanks to @cagatay-io.
### ⚙️ Settings and the window - **Settings lists its pages in six labelled groups**: Working, Appearance, Voice, Agents & Accounts, Connections, and Privacy & System; every page opens with a one-line intro. - **Frame the work area is on for new installs**, and macOS keeps the window buttons when the sidebar is collapsed (Settings > Interface > Advanced). - **The floating sidebar runs the full height, floats as a card inside the frame and keeps its traffic lights crisp**, thanks to @zxcvbinz. - **Dictation uses Hex**, Ghostex's own speech engine is gone, and Dictation and Voice Agent are separate pages with each key under its picker. - **The voice panel resizes from its edges** and follows new lines until you scroll up. - **Files groups filtered and searched files by folder**, and the Changes view can hide test files, on the computer and the phone.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **A Mac that runs gxserver without the Ghostex app can install skills**, thanks to @sebastianarena. - **Automatic account switches no longer hold back an account with room**, and a switch whose agent won't return to the shell reloads the session on the new account. - **The Gemini account shows Antigravity's Claude and GPT limits**, matching agy's /usage. - **Spaces sync keeps each folder of a repository in its own Space** and puts back Spaces that 11.0.0 folded together (#488). - **macOS: arrow keys no longer type stray characters into a Ghostex page's text fields.** - **A GBots conversation opens in the chat**, Cloud Boxes run the model and effort you picked, and Cancel stops a waiting setup at once. - **OpenCode names the provider when two providers share a model name** (#482), and push and event-stream fixes, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The Install button for Ghostex Agent Guide works**, and the Secrets row's trash button and Uninstall all remove its skill. - **Long chats load older pages faster** and gxserver starts faster with many sessions.

# Ghostex 11.0.0
## 11.0.0 - 2026-11-07
**Ghostex 11.0.0 is out.** Share a chat with anyone through a link with Ghostex Collab, let Autopilot keep your sessions moving while you are away, build your own bots on Claude Code and Codex with GBots, dictate with Hex, sync accounts, agents and skills between your computers, and annotate pages with screenshots; the iPhone gets a Live Activity, Home Screen widgets, the iPhone Duo two-pane layout, terminal themes and a Files browser.
### 🤝 Ghostex Collab
- **Share one chat through a link:** turn it on in Settings > Collab, press Share in a chat's header and send the link and its six-digit code; the other person follows the chat live in their browser, with no app and no account, and sees who is watching and typing. - **You decide what a guest's message does,** per chat: Ask me (the default) holds it as a "Message from <name>" card with Decline, Edit and Send, Send passes it straight to the agent, and View only turns their chat box off. - **A guest only ever reaches that one chat:** they can't answer the agent's questions or permission prompts, stop it, change its model, or see any other chat, file, terminal or setting. - **Links end after 24 hours by default** (1 hour, 7 days or never in Settings > Collab), Stop sharing ends one at once, Remove keeps a guest out, and the Guest messages log lists every message and who joined or left. - **The link's traffic is locked end to end** with the key in the link, so Ghostex's share relay can't read the chat; the chat itself runs on your computer. - **The phone has the same Share sheet,** the guest message cards and Settings › Collab for each computer.
### 🛟 Autopilot
- **Autopilot keeps your sessions moving while you are away:** turn it on in Settings > Autopilot, from the Autopilot pill in a coordinator's chat, on the phone, or with `ghostex autopilot on`. - **It carries on sessions that stopped too early,** interrupts a hung command after 8 minutes, reloads a session that shows nothing, restarts a terminal that ended, and moves a session at a usage limit to the account with the most room. - **It can answer questions and approval cards for you** (both off by default): unanswered questions get their recommended choice after 5, 10 or 15 minutes, and approvals follow the Heal, Heal and decide or Everything tier you pick. - **Hard limits stay yours:** pushing, merging, releasing, deleting outside the project and posting publicly are each a switch that is off until you turn it on, and sign-ins, 2FA and payments are always declined. - **A supervisor agent wakes only for judgment calls,** in an Autopilot project in your sidebar where you can read why it did each thing, and every decision is in the Log at the bottom of Settings > Autopilot. - **Pick which sessions it covers:** every session, the projects you pick, or the sessions you pick; each chat's Autopilot pill takes that session out or puts it back.
### 🤖 GBots
- **GBots are long-lived bots on your own Claude Code or Codex** that can start, message and steer agent sessions on any of your computers. Turn them on in Settings > Extensions, under Planning and automation (off by default; macOS and Linux). - **Make a bot from the Bots space** with a name, Claude Code or Codex, and its instructions; each conversation opens in the chat like any session, on the phone too. - **Bots run on the Claude and Codex accounts in Settings > Accounts,** so a bot moves to another account when one reaches its limit, and the sessions a bot starts show in your sidebar with a card naming the bot.
### 🎙️ Dictation
- **Hex is now a Dictate engine:** pick Hex in Settings > Voice to transcribe with Hex 3, the free local dictation app (macOS on Apple silicon, Windows and Linux), and your recording never leaves the computer. Install Hex installs it for you, and the phone can pick it per computer.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Make a connected computer's session a coordinator** from the sidebar's Advanced > Make Coordinator, or with `ghostex coordinator promote --computer <name>`. - **A thread on another computer is watched like one here:** it is nudged after 8 minutes with no new output and reported finished from its transcript, so it never sits at "Working" with no report. - **DeepSeek Harness can run a coordinator,** on the desktop and the phone (#480). - **A thread's and a coordinator's agent start with `GHOSTEX_COORDINATOR_ROLE`** in their environment, so a launch wrapper can tell them apart, for example to start threads with fewer MCP servers (#463). - **The board's Moving group is now called In progress.**
### 🔄 Sync
- **Accounts, Agents and Skills can sync between your paired computers** (Settings > Sync, each off by default): the Claude and Codex account list without the logins, which agents are on with their commands and order, and your own skills in `~/.agents/skills`.
### 🖍️ Browser and Files
- **Annotate captures a picture of each spot you pick,** and Send puts your notes and their pictures into the agent session you last clicked: its chat box, its terminal, or the clipboard. HTML files in the Files view get the same. - **A file link in a remote chat opens in Files** for any file in the project, and a text file outside it (an agent's log, say) opens read-only (#462). - **The Files page's fonts load again,** and a drawing opened during a project switch no longer shows "Files request timed out."
### 📱 On the phone
- **iPhone: a Live Activity lists your working and waiting agents** on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and tapping a question row opens its question card, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **iPhone: small, medium and large Home Screen widgets** show the agents that are working or waiting, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **iPhone Duo: two panes side by side** (sessions, chat, Web Preview, Files, Git Changes, Agents, Usage and Attention), a wall of session tiles, the sessions waiting for you folded above the list, and a laptop mode that keeps everything off the fold, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The phone gets the desktop's theme presets and colour controls,** terminal palettes for every terminal, and Ghostty theme file import, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **Files is a browser of the whole project** with search, a type filter, previews, Copy full path, Share and Add to session context, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **iPhone: a movable command pad** with nine keys, an Upload key and its own text editor, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **An attention list and agent notifications on the phone,** including a red "not sent" row for a message the computer couldn't send, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **Actions… lists the computer's Global Actions** after the project's, also from a Unified session's long-press menu, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The chat shows held messages with a Pick model button,** OMP's advisor notes, and a bottom sheet closes when you drag its grabber down, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **Edit machine shows whether an Easy Connect link is direct or relayed** beside "connected now". - **A pasted image is one chip in the phone's chat box,** as on the computer, and tapping anywhere on a switch row toggles it. - **Settings › Licences lists the third-party notices,** and text keeps its contrast across the phone's screens, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **Android: a terminal fling no longer crashes the app** when the session reconnects mid-scroll (#477).
### 🔔 Notifications
- **Alert me for: Needs you only** (Settings > Notifications) plays the sound and shows the notification only when an agent asks you something, waits for approval, or ends with a Blocked or Needs you section (on the phone too), thanks to @gittyforthehub. - **A failed agent run is its own red row** in the Notifications bell, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **An open question card counts as a question** in the sidebar, thanks to @cagatay-io.
### 🎨 Look and feel
- **Twenty theme presets** in Settings > Interface > Presets (Catppuccin, Dracula, Solarized, Tokyo Night, Nord, Kanagawa, Everforest and Gruvbox Material) set the whole app, chat and terminals to a theme in one click, with light-mode Full colour, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **macOS: the floating sidebar shows the window's traffic lights** while the sidebar is hidden, thanks to @zxcvbinz. - **A switch row toggles from a click anywhere on it,** not only on the switch. - **Pinned order (Manual or Most recently updated) is also in both sidebars' Sort & Filter menu,** and pinned sessions can be dragged again when Pinned mixes several projects. - **The tool card's stacked icons follow the theme** on window glass instead of drawing solid black or white circles.
### 🌐 Remote computers and Cloud Boxes
- **A computer without the agents' hooks still shows sessions going from working to finished:** Ghostex follows Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode from their own files, and `ghostex settings set` works on a computer that runs only Ghostex's server (#475). - **Session resume hooks reach a computer that runs only Ghostex's server,** from Settings > Agents with that computer picked or `ghostex agent-hooks install --all --computer <name>` (#431). - **Setting up a Mac that runs the Ghostex app as a remote computer keeps the app's own server running** (#476). - **Cloud Boxes on Instabox's free plan start,** a failed box never blocks the next one, and Claude and Codex logins reach boxes again. - **Instabox boxes run as their own user,** with your logins and secrets in a private folder only that user can read (#433).
### 🪟 Windows
- **Windows: Ghostex uses Codex's and Claude Code's own folders** when a global HOME is set (Git Bash, MSYS), so hooks, folder trust, logins and transcripts land where the agents read them. If you have a global HOME, press Install hooks once in Settings > Agents after updating (#458). - **Windows: starting from Git Bash no longer fails** while unpacking the VS Code view.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Fast Computer & Browser Use installs from GitHub** when cua.ai does not answer, on Mac, Linux and Windows. - **Ask Ghostex opens its chat within about a second** instead of waiting on the skill install. - **A Claude question with previews is answered from the chat,** and a message you send while a question is open waits for your answer (#479). - **A dialog card whose answer was refused can be dismissed,** and a Codex dialog card's pick is no longer refused when Codex only redrew the dialog (#458). - **Codex's hook trust matches what Codex 0.167 reads** (#458). - **A resume the agent can't find is never retried forever:** OMP starts fresh with your held message, and Claude and Codex mark it Not sent with Retry (#456). - **The not-moving watch leaves a session with an open question or approval alone** (#459). - **Projects that share a git remote on one computer stay separate** in the merged sidebar, while two clones of one repository still merge (#461). - **A custom agent that runs `wally codex` or `wally claude-code` keeps its own login,** thanks to @sanchitmonga22 (#478). - **Pi on Linux gets its chat** when only your shell's startup puts it on PATH (nvm, fnm, bun, pnpm), and a Pi or OMP chat that can't see its conversation says why and offers Install and restart. - **OMP: inline approvals answer through the permission picker,** Allow answers only its own card, subagent rows open their transcript, and approvals and questions notify, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **macOS: a dead key followed by a consonant no longer types a second apostrophe** (U.S. International), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **A pill strip menu opens under its pill** wherever the chat window stands, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **OpenCode no longer sits at "Waiting…" in Updates,** or offers an update mise won't install. - **`zmx` in a Ghostex session runs Ghostex's own zmx first.** - **The Gemini usage meter stacks its 5h and 7d on two lines** like Claude and Codex. - **A question tag answered on any copy is answered on every copy.** - **A new session in another project opens in Chat right away,** and a Codex boot no longer swallows a new chat's draft.

# Ghostex 10.49.0
## 10.49.0 - 2026-11-06
**Ghostex 10.49.0 is out.** A long chat no longer slows the app down, worktree sessions show under their project, coordinators get a How to use pill and a board you can click, tag and drag, Ghostex pages, forms and visuals get their names, Windows installs from PowerShell, and Ghostty 1.4, VS Code 1.145 and a newer GPUI arrive under the hood.
### ⚡ Faster and lighter
- **A long chat no longer keeps the app busy:** a chat rebuilt its whole transcript whenever the sidebar's order changed, which used close to a full CPU core on a long chat and made a pasted image take seconds to appear; it now rebuilds only what changed. - **GPUI, GPUI Kit and Zed's renderer are updated,** with fewer redundant redraws, a fix for a Windows startup stall, Zed's drag cursor fix and colour emoji on Windows.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **A How to use pill in every coordinator chat** opens the tips for working with a coordinator, each in its own card with a line you can click to put in the chat box; tick Don't show again to hide it everywhere. - **Clicking a board card opens it in place** with its whole title, latest line and links; ⌥-click or its Mention button puts it in the chat box. - **Right-click a board card (or its ⋯) for Open, Mention in chat, Tags, Mark done and Remove,** in the same menu style as the sessions sidebar. - **Board cards take the same tags as sidebar sessions,** and move between groups by drag and drop. - **A new On hold group** holds work waiting on something outside, while Blocked now means it needs you right away; a thread still not moving after Ghostex's nudge lands there by itself. - **Blocked has its own pill** next to the ? pill, and the Board pill shows only Needs you and Moving. - **Approving a thread's prompt from its card in the coordinator's chat works again;** it had been refused with "That session is not one of this coordinator's threads." - **The In progress heading in a handover is amber,** matching the board's Moving group.
### 💬 Chat
- **The things agents show in the chat have names:** a Ghostex page (gx page) is an HTML page an agent publishes, a Ghostex form (gx form) is a question form or one-click answers, and Ghostex visuals (gx visuals) are charts and tables. Ask for them by name; the old words still work. - **A Ghostex page opened from its HTML file shows styled,** from Files, a file link in the chat, Open in browser or the phone, instead of as plain HTML. - **A message you send while the agent works shows once,** not twice, when Ghostex adds a note to it. - **A picture you pasted yourself stays out of a closed fold's thumbnails;** the row that read it still shows it when the fold is open.
### 🗂️ Sidebar and projects
- **Worktree sessions show in their project:** a session in a worktree is listed under its repository's project with its branch, instead of as a separate project (Settings > Sidebar & Sessions > Advanced, on by default). - **The Unified sidebar's project header lists its computers in its tooltip** instead of showing computer pills. - **The Working shelf is now called Moving,** and the Links panel uses the same light menu surface as the rest of the sidebar.
### ⬆️ Updates and installing
- **The top bar's Updates menu shows progress:** an item you click updates in place with a spinner, the button spins while any update runs, and a failed update turns it red with a reason on hover until you dismiss it. - **Windows: install from PowerShell** with `irm https://ghostex.dev/install.ps1 | iex`, which checks the installer against GitHub's checksum and skips the browser's SmartScreen warning.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Easy Connect can use Ghostex's own relay** (Settings > Remote > Easy Connect > Relay), with Tailscale's public relays as the fallback; computers keep their current address, so no phone has to pair again.
### 🖥️ Terminal and Code view
- **Ghostty 1.4** under the terminals, built with Zig 0.17.1, with the session daemon on the same Ghostty. - **The Code view runs VS Code 1.145.0** (code-server 4.145.0). - **Windows: Claude Swap updates to 0.29.0.**

# Ghostex 10.48.0
## 10.48.0 - 2026-11-06
**Ghostex 10.48.0 is out.** One Projects list across all your computers with shared Spaces and settings sync, a Settings > Updates page for the app and every agent, a simpler Accounts page with Cursor, Gemini and Copilot usage, a local Dictate engine, chats for Pi, OMP and OpenCode that no longer drive the terminal, coordinators that heal stuck threads, and one Interface scale.
### 🗂️ One sidebar across your computers
- **One Projects list across all connected computers:** a project on several computers (same Git remote, else the same folder name) is one entry with every copy's sessions mixed, other computers' cards named, and actions run on the computer you used last. Turn on Separate by machine in Settings > Sidebar & Sessions to bring back the computer tabs. - **Spaces and project groups are shared by every connected computer** in the one list, and the Unified sidebar shows the active Space's sessions from all of them. - **Each computer has a two-letter short name** (set in Settings > Remote), shown in the sidebar's computer pills and after the branch on a Unified card. - **Every Unified card is two rows,** with the computer after the branch; drag pinned cards to put them in your own order, and project groups fold with an animation. - **Delete Worktree in the Unified sidebar:** a project header's right-click lists its worktrees, and a worktree's card has its own Delete Worktree. - **The Unified sidebar's hover buttons follow the pointer from card to card,** and a closed pinned, favorite or tagged session leaves its group instead of staying as a row whose × does nothing (#435), thanks to @roypadina.
### 🔄 Settings sync
- **Paired computers can sync Spaces, project groups, Appearance, Agent defaults, Sounds and notifications, Keybindings and Coordinator settings,** each behind its own switch in Settings > Sync (off by default, except Spaces). The newest edit wins, deletions carry everywhere, and it goes over your existing Easy Connect or Tailscale links, never through a server. Secrets never sync. - **A phone can join settings sync** and shows as Phone in Settings > Sync.
### ⬆️ Updates
- **Settings > Updates lists everything this computer uses that has an update:** the app, agent CLIs, Claude and Codex Swap, cua-driver, SpaceO, extensions, remote computers, the VS Code view and CEF, with Update all (the app last), a per-card Auto-update switch and a counted badge in the top bar. Updated agents restart into the same chat when idle. - **Gemini installed with npm from mise's Node updates through mise** instead of being refused as a manual install.
### 👤 Accounts
- **Settings > Accounts has one Add account flow:** pick a provider, the browser opens, and you land on the new account, with its usage pinned in the sidebar. A Use this account menu picks Automatically, Only when I pick it, or Paused. - **Cursor, Gemini and Copilot usage** show in Settings, the sidebar meters and the phone. - **A chat's account switcher lists only that agent's accounts,** and notices name an account by its nickname or email, never "Account 5".
### 🤖 Agents
- **Pi and OMP chats send, switch model and thinking, stop and rename through Ghostex's extension inside the agent** instead of typing into the terminal, and a model pick confirms even when an extension like pi-footer replaces the footer (#423). - **An OpenCode chat works without opening its terminal** (#418), and OpenCode conversations started outside Ghostex show under Quick Access > Sessions (#426). - **OMP chats show background jobs, agent messages and advisor notes as rows and cards** (#444), get the Subagents pill, and read OMP's symbol presets in model picks and questions (#442), thanks to @cagatay-io. - **Hermes chats stop, pick model and effort, rename and answer questions through Hermes's gateway.** - **DeepSeek Harness gets a Ghostex plugin** for its chat. - **Cursor sessions start reliably** with zen mode and oh-my-zsh prompts, and pin only real model ids (#422). - **Claude Code's Context details can show an Agent row** with the session's --agent name.
### 🧭 Coordinators

# Ghostex 10.47.0
## 10.47.0 - 2026-11-05
**Ghostex 10.47.0 is out.** Ghostex runs much lighter in the background on Windows and macOS, coordinators get a work board, agents' questions take one-click answers, the iPhone gets Voice mode, and the Unified sidebar, the new session picker and the new chat's tray are easier to use.
### ⚡ Faster and lighter
- **Windows: the Ghostex server uses far less CPU in the background,** from 2 to 3.6 cores down to about 0.13 on a busy computer with several sessions. - **Windows: reading a terminal no longer starts a helper program each time,** and background helpers no longer open a hidden console window of their own. - **Windows: Git is asked about a project again only after its files change,** for session status and diff counts, and the status line runs your command without extra launchers. - **macOS: the Ghostex server reads running sessions and saved logins itself** instead of starting a helper program several times a second, and finds agent CLIs without starting a login shell. - **Git answers are kept until the folder's files change,** so idle projects no longer run Git every few seconds. - **Ghostex starts far fewer GitHub CLI calls** for Claude cloud sessions, session links and branch pull request badges. - **A damaged line in an agent's transcript no longer makes Ghostex read the whole transcript again,** and scrolling back through a long chat's history reads only what it hasn't read yet. - **The Unified sidebar redraws once a second instead of 30 times while agents work,** with the classic sidebar's steady status dots. - **macOS: the Ghostex server raises its open-file limit,** so busy computers no longer fail sends and reads with "Too many open files".
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **A coordinator chat has a work board:** its lines of work grouped To do, Needs you, Blocked, Moving, Done and Backlog, placed from its threads, questions and pull request checks; open it from the Board pill above the chat box as a side list or a full overlay, and on the phone as a sheet. - **Board cards say what to do:** a Needs you card offers one-click answers or Answer and Approve in the thread, Done folds into a slim rail, and × twice moves a card to Removed. - **Clicking a board card puts it in the chat box as a pill,** and clicking that pill in a sent message opens the board at the card. - **A coordinator's threads on other computers show in its Workers list and under it in the sidebar** with the computer's name, and open on their own computer. - **A worker waiting for approval shows a red tag and a red dot in the Workers list.**
### 💬 Chat
- **Answer an agent's question with one click:** answer choices in its reply show as buttons under the question, and picking another one corrects the answer you sent. - **The new chat's tray is one breadcrumb** (project › computer › where › branch) that centres or wraps onto two aligned rows when narrow, with ⌥O, ⌥M, ⌥W and ⌥B to change each part. - **A Saved draft pill replaces the "Another saved draft is available" row:** it sits at the start of the pill strip, and clicking it previews the draft with Dismiss and Use draft. - **The + mention menu lists sessions on your connected computers** with their computer and project, and a mention pill for one opens it on its own computer. - **When the Ghostex server restarts, the chat waits quietly and carries on;** only a real outage shows "Couldn't reach Ghostex. It may be restarting." with Retry. - **Links in questions show their words with a dotted underline** in the text colour, also in the answered card, the ? list and Resources. - **Every pill shows its status the same way,** as small coloured dots with counts after its label, with no corner dots. - **The working bar and tool rows never show a tool's raw JSON;** an unknown tool shows its name in words. - **Marked handovers gain Comms, Held for release and Suggestions sections,** and what needs you (Read this, Blocked, Suggestions, Needs you) always comes last. - **The floating Ghostex button's panel, count tray and docked tab are frosted glass** when Glass is on.
### 🗂️ Sidebar and new sessions
- **Unified cards say Untracked for folders without Git,** always keep three rows, and show the links card when you hover. - **The Unified sidebar hides a disconnected computer's cards until it reconnects,** and leaves a coordinator's workers out, with a crew count on the coordinator's card instead. - **Right-click a Unified project header for the project menu, and drag a card into the main area** to split or open it, like a Project sidebar row. - **Reveal Active Session opens the Working shelf, project group or filter that hides the card** and flashes it, and a thin divider sets Drafts apart from the sessions below. - **The new session picker shows computers under the project name,** search starts a session in a found project, projects with the same name merge one way, and Cloud Box shows only once it is set up.
### 📱 On the phone
- **iPhone: Voice mode is here** (#412): talk with an agent in a call that the lock screen, the Dynamic Island and the green call pill show with Mute and End, and in a push-to-talk call a Live Activity on the lock screen gives you Talk and Send with the phone locked; it uses Bluetooth or CarPlay when connected and offers to hold the conversation when a phone call comes in. - **iPhone: screens with a header no longer crash on iOS 27.0.** - **The phone gets the coordinator board, one-click answers, the Saved draft pill, mentions of remote sessions and the quiet reconnect line.**
### 📄 Pages
- **Text you type in a page is never lost,** even when you quit Ghostex, reload the page or the Ghostex server restarts. - **Tooltips inside pages are frosted glass** instead of solid black or white. - **The page window stops at its ends instead of showing grey when you scroll past them,** and blurs the wallpaper by the same amount every time.
### 🎫 Work mode
- **A workspace's ticket command can be its primary tracker,** with its open tickets on the Work list, picked with `ghostex issues tracker <id>`, thanks to @lardissone (#411). - **Link a session to a ticket command's tickets by hand** with `ghostex link-session --ticket`, or Link to on the Work page, thanks to @lardissone (#414).
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **macOS: dead keys compose in terminal panes** with layouts such as U.S. International, thanks to @sebastianarena (#417). - **Windows: switching accounts works in a forked Claude session,** thanks to @DaveW001 (#415). - **Create Linear Ticket… shows only where Linear applies,** when the workspace picked Linear or a project or workspace Linear key is set. - **Opening a worker on another computer connects that computer first** if only its saved copy is known. - **A connected workspace's GitHub sign-in counts only when it holds a token,** and Settings says when its sign-in needs redoing. - **The Ghostex server ends session keepers left behind by a deleted Ghostex server** when it starts. - **Resources' row buttons line up,** so orphaned rows' × sits under the session rows' ×.
